Chapter 1074: 16: Lin Yuan Tears The Sky (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2

Chapter 1074: Chapter 16: Lin Yuan Tears the Sky (Seeking Monthly Ticket)_2

Only by winning can I avoid losing everything and gain an inheritance that might guide my own path, at least making it seem worthwhile.

“Ever since I stepped into the Chaos Realm, I have painstakingly cultivated for ten Cosmic Eras and created ten ultimate killing techniques,” Nine Profound Venerable said gravely. “If you can block them, how about I admit defeat willingly?”

As soon as his voice fell.

BOOM—

Nine Profound Venerable suddenly launched a punch.

A single punch unleashed terrifying ripples, piercing through a radius of ten thousand light years, hundreds of thousands, millions of light years. Space-time ripped apart like glue, and all the might surged toward Lin Yuan.

“The Space-Time Grindstone…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and all directions of space-time solidified. Infinite power from space-time began relentlessly wearing down the force of Nine Profound Venerable’s punch, dissipating it into the depths of countless layers of space-time.

“Such an ingenious manipulation of space-time?”

Nine Profound Venerable’s expression grew solemn,

for his punch also contained Space-Time Rules.

Lin Yuan’s ability to block it using Space-Time Rules demonstrated that Lin Yuan was superior in pure space-time contest.

“So what if your comprehension of Space-Time Rules is stronger?”

Nine Profound Venerable remained unconcerned,

because this was a sparring match between them, not a test of escape or survival techniques. A deeper comprehension of Space-Time Rules couldn’t necessarily ensure victory over him.

“A venerable who excels in offensive techniques?”

Lin Yuan gazed back at Nine Profound Venerable. That punch just now contained exceedingly horrifying might. If Lin Yuan had manifested either the singular Taiyang Divine Spirit or Taiyin Primordial Spirit instead of his most powerful Taiji Primordial Spirit, he might have already sustained some injuries from that strike.

“Three Profounds Breaks Heaven and Earth.”

Nine Profound Venerable’s aura began to surge explosively, as three distinct forces manifested within him, converging toward Lin Yuan to crush him.

“Infinite Void.”

Lin Yuan didn’t choose to counter directly but stepped forward instead. The surrounding void grew vast and sweeping, replaced by a completely new power.

The Thirteenth-step Legacy, “Infinite Void,” belonged to foundational inheritance, its focus being the formation of an unparalleled foundation that allowed for absolute crushing dominance. Over the years, Lin Yuan had also devised a few killing moves based on the universe within his body, and Infinite Void was one of them.

RUMBLE.

The two forces, utterly distinct, continuously collided and intertwined, sending shockwaves out to infinitely distant locations.

The defensive formation of the Nine Profound Secret Realm frantically activated, trying its best to resist the incoming aftershocks.

…

The battle between two Venerable-level existences caused impacts so vast that it soon drew the attention of other venerables within the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.

“Hmm? A venerable is taking action?”

“That location—it’s Nine Profound?”

“Who is the venerable fighting Nine Profound?”

“No idea, I’ve never witnessed such an aura before.”

…

One by one, the Chaos Venerables observed from afar. None of them had any intention of intervening; instead, they started chatting idly.

“Even during his Sovereign Realm days, Nine Profound excelled in slaughter, and stepping into the Chaos Realm hasn’t changed him.”

“That unfamiliar venerable, capable of trading blows with Nine Profound, must have an extraordinary background.”

“To become a venerable, who among us could be simple?”

“True, let’s just watch.”

…

The Chaos Venerables watched the battle unfold. Among Chaos Venerables, it was common practice to avoid fighting each other unless absolutely necessary.

Still, Chaos Venerables loved to witness duels and fights between their peers.

After all, for them, it posed no threats. The combatants weren’t establishing enmities against them.

Who doesn’t enjoy a good spectacle?

…

The void solidified as though tangible, expanding and covering the surroundings. Using “Infinite Void” as the foundation, Lin Yuan’s killing move, Infinite Void, showcased absolute control over the void. Though it hadn’t reached the level of the Divine Ability ‘World,’

it approximated one-third the strength of the Divine Ability ‘World.’

The latter, however, was limited by its duration, lasting mere seconds, whereas Infinite Void had no such limitation. Lin Yuan could maintain it as long as he wished.

“Such a terrifying void suppression.” Even Nine Profound Venerable felt troubled.

Under the suppression of Infinite Void, his every move faced significant constraints, as though he was an insect ensnared within a spider’s web—an immensely unpleasant sensation.

“But it’s useless against me.”

“Six Profounds Subdues All Things.”

Nine Profound Venerable’s face contorted slightly in ferocity. Within moments, six entirely new forces enveloped his body, sweeping outward.

Determined to defeat Lin Yuan and avoid a crushing loss, Nine Profound Venerable had nearly used up most of his killing techniques.

RUMBLE.

The invisible power of Six Profounds began demolishing the void, and the Infinite Void driven by Lin Yuan started to tremble.

“Hmm?” Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

The Six Profounds force unleashed by Nine Profound Venerable had yet to completely destabilize Infinite Void, but given time, it was inevitable.

Infinite Void struggled to suppress the full-power force of Nine Profound Venerable’s Six Profounds.

“Fighting a venerable using the Taiji Primordial Spirit is still a bit forced.” Lin Yuan reflected inwardly.

Ultimately, Lin Yuan was still just a Path Splitting Realm lifeform, forcefully crossing two major realms to battle a venerable. Even being a direct descendant of a Thirteenth-step lifeform with immense innate blessings, this feat was nearly impossible.

Lin Yuan had only reached this level thanks to his numerous fortuitous encounters and deep foundations.

“If that’s the case, I’ll just use my trump card directly.”

Lin Yuan made his decision; given Nine Profound Venerable’s displayed strength, conventional means were unlikely to overpower him, let alone secure victory.

“World…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes closed slightly before opening again.

In that instant.

The surrounding void transformed.

An incomparably stable and overwhelming aura filled the space.

Within this domain, all time and space were affected. Lin Yuan became the sole Creator of this void.
